name: National Museum of Mexican Art
tagline: The largest Latino cultural institution in the US, in the heart of Pilsen. Free admission, always.
description: Largest Latino cultural institution in the United States, with a permanent collection of more than 18,000 works tracing 3,000 years of Mexican, Mexican-American, and Chicano art. Located in the Pilsen neighborhood — the museum is reason enough to visit, and Pilsen itself rewards a longer walk.

tips.text: Admission has been free since the museum opened in 1987.
Stay for lunch in Pilsen — Carnitas Uruapan is two blocks away.

highlights.item: Day of the Dead exhibit (open Oct–Dec)
Rotating exhibitions of contemporary Chicano art

distance_landmark: Pilsen, 2.5 mi southwest of the Loop
